Notes

Different years have treated this question differently. Until 2017, this question was not asked to those who responded “Hispanic” in the race question. From 2018-2022, this question was asked to all respondents. From 2024, the value of these questions for all those who said they were Hispanic appear to have been set to Yes. For a combined version of race and hispanic, see race_h (any-part Hispanic), which is more stable version. See hisp_origin for more details on hispanic origin
